sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Classify the product of the non-zero rational number 4 and the irrational number √5 as rational or irrational, and be ready to justify it.
Option A delivers 56 units of output over 7 hours. Option B delivers 120 units over 15 hours. Which has the greater output per hour?
choices: There is not enough information without knowing the total hours available.

items.prompt: A rectangular plot measures 24.2 m by 26.2 m, each measured to the nearest tenth of a metre. Report the area to 2 decimal places.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: You are building a model of the population density of a county. Which unit should the modelled quantity be reported in?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A bottling line operates at 37 grams per second. Express this rate in kilograms per hour.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
